messages:
Ravi P: Heads-up for the night window (00:00-03:00 UTC). Plan to roll runtime quant-kernel v2.4 -> v2.5 (qbuild-2026-03-19-87) across serving hosts. Canary -> ramp sequence: 1% -> 5% -> 25%. Owner: Maya L. Rollback criteria listed below. Ping if you have concerns.
DeployBot: Scheduled staged rollout for kernel v2.5 (qbuild-2026-03-19-87). Canary hosts: runtime-canary-01..03. Canary window: 00:05-00:20 UTC.
Maya L: Quick Q — did we validate the kernel ABI with gemm fallback paths? Last time we saw shape mismatch on mixed inputs.
Sam T: I ran microbenchmarks on quant-v2.5 last night. p50 improved, p99 has small fluctuations at long seq (2k). Perf gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/abc123
Jenna C: Can we increase the initial canary to 5% for 15m? 1% might not surface memory fragmentation on some hosts.
Kai H: Suggest telemetry triggers: matmul_err_rate > 0.1% OR decode_rate drop > 5% -> auto-rollback. Also keep old kernel pinned on 10% capacity for warm fallback.
Ravi P: Updated plan: 1% -> 5% after 10m -> 25% after another 20m. Keep v2.4 pinned at 15% for 60m. Rollback triggers: matmul_err_rate > 0.05% sustained for 5m OR token p99 > baseline +15% for 10m.
DeployBot: Preflight checks passed: ABI-compat, KVcache-compat, quant-sanity. All canary hosts healthy.
OpsAlert: FYI infra maintenance in us-east-1 is scheduled at 01:00 UTC during the change window — ops will pause autoscaling for ~40m.
Maya L: Noted, we'll avoid scheduling heavy batch tasks during the window. Need release notes/changelog for customers; I'll draft a short blurb.
Sam T: If matmul flakiness appears, immediate action = pin traffic to v2.4, revoke qbuild flag, escalate to runtime oncall. Runbook up-to-date?
Jenna C: Runbook: https://redwood.dev/runbooks/runtime-kernel-rollback (last updated 2026-02-18). I'll add qbuild-2026-03-19-87 and owner info.
Ravi P: Pin command for deploybot if we need an immediate revert: 
```
deploybot pin --service runtime --from v2.5 --to v2.4 --percent 100 --reason "auto-rollback"
```
Kai H: :thumbsup: I'll add the extra Prom queries to the canary dashboard. Also request ML to run inference-level regression on a 50k prompt sample during the 10m canary.
Maya L: ML contact @Aisha — can you run the regression at ~00:10 UTC? Should take ~12m.
Aisha: Aisha: Affirmative. I'll run checks on redwood-7b, rwl-13b, open-ggml-13b-quant and post summary here.
DeployBot: Canary progressed: 1% -> 5% at 00:16 UTC. Telemetry snapshot: p95 latency +2.8%, matmul_err_rate 0.01%.
Sam T: Seeing slight mem jitter on canary-02, not over threshold yet, keeping an eye.
Aisha: Regression complete: no quality regressions on primary tests. Tiny tokenization mismatch on rwl-13b in 0.04% of cases.
Ravi P: OK. Proceed to 25% at 00:40 UTC unless objections in 5m.
Jenna C: No objections.
Kai H: Approve, will monitor dashboards closely.
DeployBot: Progress: 25% rollout started at 00:41 UTC.
OpsAlert: Note: infra maintenance shifted to 01:20 UTC, ops will pause ASG 01:20-02:00 UTC.
Sam T: If p99 spikes >20% after 25% ramp, throttle rollout and revert to 5%.
Ravi P: Agreed. Post-rollout checklist: collect heap dumps from canary-02, kernel logs from runtime-host-12, and attach qbuild-2026-03-19-87 artifacts to release notes. I'll post a short release note draft after the window.
